```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Purpose
Get Miami University's on-campus housing cost from its cost-of-attendance page, to use as a benchmark for off-campus rent.

## Check permission
```{r robots}
robotstxt::paths_allowed(paths = "/onestop/costs/coa-by-cohort.html", domain = "miamioh.edu")
```

## Read every table on the page
```{r tables}
coa_page = rvest::read_html("https://miamioh.edu/onestop/costs/coa-by-cohort.html")
coa_nodes = coa_page |> rvest::html_elements("table")
miami_tables = coa_nodes |> rvest::html_table()

# the heading above each table, so we know which cohort/campus it is
headings = purrr::map_chr(.x = coa_nodes, .f = \(t) t |>
  rvest::html_element(xpath = "preceding::*[self::h2 or self::h3 or self::h4][1]") |>
  rvest::html_text2())

length(miami_tables)
headings
names(miami_tables[[1]])

# the Housing row from every table
purrr::map(.x = miami_tables, .f = \(t) t |>
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_any(1, \(x) stringr::str_detect(x, "Housing"))))
```

## Save the raw tables and keep the benchmark
```{r benchmark}
# all 5 tables with their headings, saved as raw data
miami_all = purrr::map2_df(.x = miami_tables, .y = seq_along(miami_tables),
                           .f = \(t, i) t |> dplyr::mutate(table_number = i, heading = headings[i]))
readr::write_csv(miami_all, "data/miami_coa_raw.csv")

# the benchmark: 2027 cohort, Oxford on-campus housing
miami_tables[[1]] |>
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(Description, "Housing")) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    benchmark    = "Miami on-campus housing (2027 cohort)",
    per_semester = readr::parse_number(`Per Semester`),
    per_year     = readr::parse_number(Annually),
    per_month    = per_year / 9   # school year is about 9 months
  ) -> miami_housing

miami_housing
readr::write_csv(miami_housing, "data/miami_housing.csv")
```
